def bpr_sequence_loss(
    model: nn.Module,
    seq: torch.Tensor,
    pos: torch.Tensor,
    neg: torch.Tensor,
    terminal_count: int | None = None,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    if terminal_count is not None and terminal_count not in (0, pos.shape[0]):
        raise ValueError("A training batch must contain exactly one objective branch")
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    valid = pos != 0
    differences = (neg_scores - pos_scores).masked_fill(~valid, 0.0)
    losses = torch.nn.functional.softplus(differences).masked_fill(~valid, 0.0)
    return losses.sum() / valid.sum().clamp(min=1)

### >>> Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-START: Validate single-branch BPR and normalize only supervised targets
def bpr_sequence_loss(
    model: nn.Module,
    seq: torch.Tensor,
    pos: torch.Tensor,
    neg: torch.Tensor,
    terminal_count: int | None = None,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    if seq.ndim != 2 or pos.shape != seq.shape or neg.shape != seq.shape:
        raise ValueError("BPR inputs must have matching B x L shapes")
    if terminal_count is not None and terminal_count not in (0, pos.shape[0]):
        raise ValueError("A training batch must contain exactly one objective branch")
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    valid = pos != 0
    differences = (neg_scores - pos_scores).masked_select(valid)
    if differences.numel() == 0:
        raise ValueError("BPR batch has no supervised targets")
    # This is the same sampled position loss and token reduction. Unselected
    # positions do not contribute, and malformed empty batches fail explicitly.
    return torch.nn.functional.softplus(differences).mean()
